Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates software engineering by asking models to generate patches that fix real issues in open-source Python repositories, validated by tests in a standardized harness. The "Verified" subset uses human-verified problem instances to reduce noise and ensure tasks are solvable and correctly specified.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory
L3: Self-reflection (minor)

Description: SWE-bench Multilingual extends SWE-bench-style repo-level bug-fix tasks beyond Python to multiple programming languages, assessing whether models can adapt their coding and debugging skills across ecosystems and tooling. It emphasizes cross-language generalization under realistic repository constraints and test-based verification.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory
L3: Cognitive Flexibility

Description: SWE-bench Pro is a harder, more industrially oriented software engineering benchmark with more complex issues and broader language/tooling demands than SWE-bench Verified.
